newsitem.title: USA: Intrav sees Q4 most profitable of year.
newsitem.headline: Intrav sees Q4 most profitable of year.

text.p: Intrav Inc said Friday it expects the fourth quarter to be its most profitable quarter of 1996.
"We expect the net income for the fourth quarter to be consistent with the 1995 level," President Larry Nolan said in a statement.
In the year-ago quarter the travel program operator reported earnings of $2.2 million, or $0.40 per share.

"Our business is seasonal, with higher activity typically occurring in the third and fourth quarters of the year, and our 1996 results are no exception," Nolan said. "Consistent with the prior year, fourth quarter results are expected to include the operation of three departures of our Around the World by Supersonic Concorde Program."
Intrav today reported third-quarter earnings of $1.4 million, or $0.26 per share, up from $1.3 million, or $0.25 per share, a year earlier. Program revenues rose to $35.4 million from $28.2 million.
